name: biodecision-tev1-4b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 4.66 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-09-25. Caveats: decision model - returns a calibrated probability per option in one forward pass and generates no text, so it is excluded from the worth-running ranking and belongs on the Decision Index. Licence is research-only, not open for commercial use. Card reports 70.5 held-out accuracy for stage-1 and 70.2 merged, i.e. merging cost 0.3pt. MEDIQA-RQE is LOWER than Together Tev1-4B (72.6 vs 78.3).
